purpose: Identity audit of repeated Gaborone LotId=681 and safe cadastral references across the first five cells of the existing adapter run.

coordinateReferenceSystem.metricMethod: proj4 coordinate transformation then planar polygon area and Turf intersection in meters

privacy: No owner-like Name, ExecutingO, Responsibl, or other contact fields requested.

interpretation.geometryFinding: The four returned polygons do not overlap in EPSG:32735. FID 9102 and FID 9103 are disjoint and 82.906 m apart. All four rows carry the same LotId, Town_Lot_I, Extension_, SR_No, and Diagram_No, so geometry and these survey references alone cannot distinguish separate parcels from disconnected components of one surveyed plot. FID 47651 is about 5.42 km from FID 9102; areas range from 0.27 m2 to 449.71 m2. This leaves the legal multipart interpretation unresolved.
interpretation.bestTestedIdentity: [LotId, OBJECTID_1] is the best candidate among fields tested in these bounded samples: nonempty and unique on 16 unique FID rows across five retained cells, it separates all four complete LotId=681 matches, and the existing adapter returned all 16 viewport features and passed fresh exact rereads with geometry hashes equal. A fresh exact adapter reread of all four LotId=681 rows also passed.
interpretation.identityLimit: Uniqueness/stability is demonstrated only in this bounded sample and the complete LotId=681 match set. The service metadata does not state that OBJECTID_1 is a persistent cadastral identifier, so the pair remains a candidate, not a citywide guarantee.
interpretation.notRecommended: LotId alone and [LotId, Town_Lot_I] fail uniqueness. [LotId, SR_No], [LotId, Diagram_No], and [LotId, Town_Lot_I, SR_No, Diagram_No] fail or have missing values. OBJECTID was unique in this sample but returned zero for FID 47651; FID is the transport OID and must not be elevated to parcel identity solely to suppress the LotId conflict.
interpretation.fallback: If OBJECTID_1 cannot be established as stable, use a source-scoped geometry-hash identity path rather than presenting FID as native parcel identity.
